stories.title: Microsoft Releases Emergency Windows Updates to Block Compromised eMudhra Certificates
stories.description: Microsoft issued emergency Windows updates after finding eight recoverable eMudhra CA keys that could enable forged trusted certificates.

stories.title: Hackers Use CyberStrikeAI Agents to Automate Network Scanning, Exploitation, and Data Theft
stories.description: Hackers abused CyberStrikeAI to coordinate 44 AI agents targeting 19 organizations, including 16 in Japan, for automated cyberattacks.

stories.title: Secrets Management Firm Infisical Valued at $600 Million After $40 Million Raise
stories.description: The company will use the Series B funds to expand its platform for securing AI agents’ access to sensitive systems.

stories.title: Coinbase Customer Data Exposed Via Analytics Vendor Amplitude Security Incident
stories.description: Coinbase has disclosed that a security incident at analytics provider Amplitude exposed contact information belonging to a small subset of its customers.

stories.title: CISA Warns of PHP2Shell Vulnerabilities Actively Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: CISA added two actively exploited PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its KEV catalog for enabling unauthenticated remote code execution.

stories.title: Hackers Start Probing Fresh Oracle EBS Vulnerability
stories.description: CVE-2026-101767 is an unauthenticated SQL injection that can be exploited for remote code execution.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Node2Shell Exploitation as Honeypots Log Attack Attempts
stories.description: CISA added the Brotli flaw to its KEV catalog, and two honeypot operators logged attempts, including one that used a broken exploit.

stories.title: Anthropic's Unreleased AI Model Chains Flaws Into Working Chrome, Safari, Windows and Linux Exploits
stories.description: Anthropic says an unreleased AI model built five working exploit chains across major platforms in lab tests; the reported flaws are patched.

stories.title: FBI Seizes Virtualine Domain Over Alleged Criminal Hosting and Bitcoin Money Laundering
stories.description: The FBI seized Virtualine's domain as the DoJ accused the bulletproof hosting provider of facilitating cybercrime and laundering illicit payments.

stories.title: Japan's GMO Offers $1 Million Bounty to Catch Hackers Behind FX Trading Cloud Breach
stories.description: GMO offers up to $1 million for tips leading to arrests after its Desktop Cloud breach exposed customer data and was linked to unauthorized FX trades.

stories.title: Tailscale Patches SSH Flaws That Could Let Hacked Devices Gain Root Access on Other Servers
stories.description: Tailscale 1.104.4 fixes SSH forwarding flaws that could expose root-only sockets, while related issues remain unpatched in headscale.
